dogecoin.text:
#Ether and #Dogecoin continue to scale heights even as Bitcoin trades in the red. Doge close to $0.50 & ETH close to $3500

#Doge #Ethereum #cryptos
What would you do if #dogecoin hits 1$ ?
But the two cryptocurrencies are still astronomically higher than a year ago. Bitcoin is up 323% according to Coinbase, while Dogecoin is up 670%.
Along with the Bitcoin crash, other major cryptos fell on Wednesday. Ethereum plunged 14%, trading at $2,494, a 31% drop from the peak reached last week. Dogecoin lost 13%.
Coinbase has started accepting inbound transfers for Dogecoin (DOGE), setting the stage for further adoption of the meme-based digital asset. https://t.co/1mUtWDeZNK
